newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - COPENHAGEN CSD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - COPENHAGEN CSD, N.Y..

text.p: Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of Copenhagen Central School District, Lewis and Jefferson Counties, New York, at the Office of Roosevelt & Cross, 47th Floor Conference Room, 20 Exchange Place, New York, New York 10022, until 11:00 o'clock A.M., Prevailing Time, on the

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase INFEDERALFUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $3,000,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said School District, dated August 15, 1997, with interest thereon payable on December 15, 1997 and semi- annually thereafter on June 15 and December 15, and maturing June 15 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

THE SCHOOLDISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE THOMSON MUNICIPAL NEWS (FORMERLY KNOWN AS MUNIFACTS) WIRE.

Each bid, accompanied by a $60,000 good faith check, must be for all of said $3,000,000 bonds. Award will be made based on net interest cost. The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of O'Hara & O'Connell, Syracuse, New York, Bond Counsel.

Bidders must refer to the complete Notice of Bond Sale for the terms and conditions of the sale. To obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Official Statement of the School District, please contact Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., telephone: (315) 699-7912, telecopier: (315) 699-8833.
Dated: Copenhagen, New York ROBERT F. STACKE
